caption:
Read these four verses slowly

Surah Al-Ikhlaas describes Allah in a few short lines: He is One, the Eternal Refuge, He neither begets nor is begotten, and nothing is comparable to Him.

Surah Al-Ikhlaas 112:1-4

Which of these four lines will you reflect on today?

#surahikhlas #tawheed #quranreels #namesofallah

Recitation: Mishary Alafasy
